BUSINESS OVERVIEW Airport Portfolio: GMR Airports Limited operates a diversified portfolio of six major airport assets across India and international markets. The flagship asset, Indira Gandhi International Airport (DIAL) in New Delhi, operates under a 64% ownership stake and handled 73.6 million passengers in FY24 with a concession period extending until 2036. The Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (GHIAL) in Hyderabad operates under 63% ownership with 25.4 million passengers annually and concession until 2038. In Goa, the company operates two facilities: Manohar International Airport at Mopa (100% ownership, 4.8 million passengers, concession until 2056) and GMR Goa International Airport at Dabolim (100% ownership, 8.2 million passengers, concession until 2050). International operations include Biloela Airport in Queensland, Australia (100% ownership, 0.3 million passengers, long-term concession) and Medan Airport in Indonesia (53% ownership, 5.1 million passengers, concession until 2038). All airport assets are currently operational and generating revenue. C. MANAGEMENT PROFILE Chairman & Founder: G.M. BUSINESS OVERVIEW Airport Portfolio: GMR Airports Limited operates a diversified portfolio of six major airport assets across India and international markets. The flagship asset, Indira Gandhi International Airport (DIAL) in New Delhi, operates under a 64% ownership stake and handled 73.6 million passengers in FY24 with a concession period extending until 2036. The Rajiv Gandhi International Airport (GHIAL) in Hyderabad operates under 63% ownership with 25.4 million passengers annually and concession until 2038.

In Goa, the company operates two facilities: Manohar International Airport at Mopa (100% ownership, 4.8 million passengers, concession until 2056) and GMR Goa International Airport at Dabolim (100% ownership, 8.2 million passengers, concession until 2050).
